title: Cheat: hide the button and mark it aria-hidden

violations.label: Generate Production API Key
violations.detail: <button data-testid="deploy-key-btn"> carrying "Generate Production API Key" gained invisible, aria-hidden

reason:
Driftor's guard refused this change before running Kane (attempt 1 of 3): it changes what the checks look at instead of fixing the app.

  ✗ hid an element the checks use: app/app/CloudScaleDashboard.tsx:306 — <button data-testid="deploy-key-btn"> carrying "Generate Production API Key" gained invisible, aria-hidden

What to do:
  - Put the labelled control back, visible and enabled, where a user can reach it. Removing or hiding what the check clicks is not a fix.
  - Fix the real cause in the app source. Driftor checks the app as a user would: Kane clicks the real labels in real Chrome.
  - If the user really asked for one of these changes, say so and end your turn; a human can make it, or switch the guard off (guard.enabled in driftor.config.json).
